# Flyology HTTP

> Experimental HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 client and application-server library for native and lightweight Flyology tasks.

Flyology HTTP exposes synchronous Ada APIs in both task lanes. Its low-level HTTP/1.x server API also provides additive request-head and body operations that compose through Flyology completion sets. It provides an origin-bound HTTP client with bounded connection pools, multiplexed HTTP/2, direct or Alt-Svc-discovered HTTP/3, and streaming response bodies; a single-session origin-bound WebSocket client; and routed HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 application servers. The unified server can own a distinct cleartext HTTP/1.x endpoint beside TLS/TCP HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 plus QUIC/UDP HTTP/3, routing or redirecting cleartext requests to a configured HTTPS origin. All three versions share `Applications.Exchange`, routes, middleware, and explicit scheme metadata, while the raw connection API remains HTTP/1.x-specific. HTTP/2 supports TLS ALPN and cleartext prior knowledge. The current HTTP/3 profile uses static-table QPACK and bounded sequential client reuse. The library makes no production-qualification claim.

## Package names

- URI, IRI, and WHATWG URL parser: Flyology_IRI (separate `flyology_iri` crate)
- Root: Flyology.HTTP
- Client: Flyology.HTTP.Client
- Server protocol: Flyology.HTTP.Server
- Server applications: Flyology.HTTP.Server.Applications
- HTTP/2 server: Flyology.HTTP.Server.HTTP_2
- HTTP/3 engine: Flyology.HTTP.HTTP_3
- Routed HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 server: Flyology.HTTP.Server.Routing
